summary_sentence: MCP shows real adoption in creator workflows this cycle: rileybrown.ai's 39k-engagement Blender-via-Claude demo, Figma-MCP and Expo-MCP being threaded into vibe-coding stacks, and Higgsfield MCP enabling Claude-driven ad generation; bigpictureclub surfaces three Anthropic-flagged security risks (Gmail-send MCP, Chrome full-access, third-party Skills) as the substantive critique counter to the demo flood.
praises: rileybrown.ai shows MCP letting Claude actually control Blender, generating multi-square grids from natural-language prompts in a 39k-engagement demo
agentic.james threads Expo's MCP server into a Swift-avoidant React Native iOS workflow so Claude can autonomously test mobile apps on the iOS simulator
handlytech demonstrates Higgsfield MCP letting Claude generate full cinematic AI ad spots with camera movement and product shots
complaints: bigpictureclub surfaces three Anthropic-flagged MCP security risks: Cowork+Gmail configured to send, Claude-for-Chrome full site access, third-party skills in Claude Code
anatomyofai positions MCP-style Claude prompts as a privacy-safer alternative to OpenAI's new financial connector, framing the connector pattern itself as a data-privacy and cybersecurity exposure
